newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-ATAPATTU CENTURY HELPS SRI LANKA TO 302-4.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ATAPATTU CENTURY HELPS SRI LANKA TO 302-4.

text.p: Opener Marvan Atapattu scored his maiden one-day international century on Sunday to help Sri Lanka to 302 for four in the first of three matches against India.
He was run out in the final over for 118, scored off 153 balls with seven fours.
Atapattu played the anchor role in a first wicket stand of 91 in 14 overs with Sanath Jayasuriya, who blitzed 73 off 52 balls with two sixes and 10 boundaries.
India's ploy in trying to curb the big-hitting Jayasuriya by opening the innings with off-spinner Rajesh Chauhan failed, his 10 overs costing 64 runs.
Roshan Mahanama and Atapattu then put on 108 for the second wicket. Mahanama made 53 off 58 balls with one six and three fours.
With Aravinda de Silva chipping in with 34 at a run a ball, Sri Lanka maintained a run rate around six an over.
Prasad was India's most successful bowler, taking two for 50 in his nine overs.
